blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We generally perceive that training text-to-image diffusion models requires heavy compute: it is true if we aim at a comprehensive frontier model. This understanding prevents people from training their own models when getting started in the field. We develop MiniDog, a framework that enables pretraining diffusion transformers in 55 minutes and fine-tuning in another 15 minutes on four 3090 GPUs. For data, we use 26k dog images from ImageNet and caption them for pretraining and use 2k images generated by FLUX.1-schnell for fine-tuning. We precompute the image and text features and cache them for efficiency. For architecture, we use E2E-INVAE for its semantic latent space, a small transformer with 22M parameters, a small Qwen model for text encoding, and in-context conditioning. For training, we use iREPA and an EUPE perception encoder for acceleration. For evaluation, our repository supports FID, HPSv2 score, PickScore, and various VAE reconstruction metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们一般认为,培训文本到图像传播模型需要沉重的计算:如果我们着眼于一个全面的前沿模型,这是事实。 这种理解阻碍了人们在开始实地工作时训练自己的模特. 我们开发了MiniDog,这个框架可以在55分钟内对扩散变压器进行预先训练,并在4个3090GPU上再作15分钟的微调. 对于数据,我们使用来自ImageNet的26k狗图像,并给它们作预训的字幕,并使用由FLUX.1-schnell生成的2k图像进行微调. 我们预先计算图像和文本功能,并缓存它们以提高效率. 对于建筑,我们使用E2E-INVAE作为其语义潜入空间,一个有22M参数的小型变压器,一个用于文本编码的小型Quen模型,以及内文本的配置. 在培训方面,我们使用iREPA和一个EUPE感知编码器来加速. 对于评价,我们的存储器支持FID,HPSv2分数,PickScore,以及各种VAE重建度量衡.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Training diffusion models is computationally heavy, especially for frontier models. In the community, beginners often struggle to find the opportunity to do the whole pipeline. This paper presents MiniDog, a simple yet useful codebase, where pretraining and fine-tuning of text-to-image (T2I) models can be performed in about an hour and 15 minutes, respectively, on four 3090 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 培训推广模式在计算上很重,特别是前沿模式。 在社区中,初学者往往为寻找机会来完成整个管道而挣扎. 本文介绍的MiniDog是一个简单而有用的代码库,在4个3090 GPU上,文本到图像(T2I)模型的预训和微调分别可以在大约1小时和15分钟内完成.

blocks.en: Concept. This material presents data, architecture, training methods, and evaluation metrics for T2I model training. Flow-matching beginners can train their own T2I models efficiently.
blocks.zh: 概念。 这些材料介绍了T2I模式培训的数据、架构、培训方法和评价衡量标准。 流量匹配初学者可以高效地训练自己的T2I型.

blocks.en: Leveling and prerequisite knowledge. The material targets advanced undergraduate and graduate courses and assumes linear algebra, calculus, probability, and deep learning.
blocks.zh: 水平和先决条件知识。 材料以高级本科和研究生课程为目标,并假定线性代数,微积分,概率,和深度学习.

blocks.en:
Latent diffusion [ 12 ] trains the denoiser on the compressed latents of a tokenizer
(a VAE) instead of pixels. VAVAE [ 7 ] aligns these latents with a pretrained
vision encoder, distilling its semantics into the tokenizer so that the latents are easier to
learn. REPA-E [ 13 ] goes further: besides bringing in these semantics, it enables
joint optimization of the tokenizer and the diffusion model.

视觉编码器,将它的语义分解成活化器,这样潜伏物就更容易
学习。 REPA-E [13] 更进一步:除了引进这些语义外,它还使

blocks.en: 3 The MiniDog resource
blocks.zh: 3个 迷你狗资源

blocks.en:
Data. Pretraining uses 26,000 recaptioned ImageNet [ 16 ] images of 20 dog breeds. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) uses 2,000 high-quality images of the same breeds that we generate with FLUX.1-schnell [ 17 ] from text prompts written by GPT-5.5
in the same structure as the real-photo captions. Evaluation uses 500 held-out prompts. All three datasets have been released on HuggingFace .

blocks.en: Pipeline is depicted in Fig. 2 , where we adopt the DiffusionBench framework [ 18 ] . During pretraining, we pass the image caption through Qwen3-0.6B [ 14 ] and obtain text tokens. The paired image is fed to a VAE and an external vision encoder ( e.g ., DINOv2). Noise is added to the image latent. Timestep and text tokens are concatenated with the noisy latents into one sequence (in-context conditioning [ 4 ] ) and this sequence is fed into the diffusion transformer. The vision perception tokens, on the other hand, are used to align with intermediate diffusion features (REPA loss Eq. 2 ) at Block 4, where our diffusion transformer has 12 blocks in total. The flow matching loss (Eq. 1 ) is also applied. At the SFT stage, we turn off the REPA loss and only use flow matching loss.
blocks.zh: 管道在图2中被描绘出来,我们在那里采用了"分化奔驰"框架[18]. 在预训期间,我们将图像字幕通过Quen3-0.6B[14]并获得文本符号. 配对的图像被喂入一个VAE和一个外视编码器(如DINOv2). 噪声被添加到图像中的潜在。 时序和文字符号会由噪音潜入到一个序列中来相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 而视觉感知符则被用来配合中间扩散特性(REPA loss Eq. 2),位于第4区,我们的扩散变压器共有12个区块. 流量匹配损失(Eq. 1)也被应用. 在SFT阶段,我们关闭了REPA损失,只使用流量匹配损失.

blocks.en: The tokenizer (VAE) is always frozen. Images are encoded into latents which are cached and reused during training: this reduces training time significantly. Unless otherwise stated, we pretrain for 200 epochs ( ∼ \sim 20k steps) and SFT for 100 epochs ( ∼ \sim 700 steps). Appendix C lists all hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 活化剂(VAE)总是被冷冻. 图像被编码成潜伏物,在训练中被缓存并再利用:这大大缩短了训练时间。 除非另有说明,否则我们为200个纪元(\\ sim 20k steps)和SFT为100个纪元(\\ sim 700 steps)预训. 附 录 C列出所有超参数.

blocks.en: Methods supported . From architecture point of view, MiniDog supports latent diffusion with a 12-block transformer with 22.06M parameters and in-context conditioning. For VAE, the project supports E2E-INVAE and E2E-VAVAE [ 13 ] . For REPA, we support original REPA and iREPA. Various vision encoders can be used, including DINOv2, DINOv3 [ 19 ] , PE-Spatial [ 20 ] , and EUPE [ 15 ] . Our repository also allows for supervised fine-tuning and reward-model-based scoring.
blocks.zh: 方法得到支持。 从建筑角度看,MiniDog支持以12块变压器进行潜在扩散,并配有22.06M参数和内文本调节. 对于VAE,项目支持E2E-INVAE和E2E-VAVAE[13]. 对于REPA,我们支持原始REPA和iREPA. 可以使用各种视觉编码器,包括DINov2,DINov3 [19],PE-Spatial [20],以及EUPE [15]. 我们的储存库还允许监督地微调和以奖励模式为基础的评分。

blocks.en: We measure generation quality using gFID [ 21 ] . Specifically, we use all the 26k real pretraining images as the reference set and generate 26k images using the same pretraining prompts. The two sets of images are used for gFID calculation. We measure tokenizer reconstruction using PSNR, SSIM [ 22 ] , LPIPS [ 23 ] and rFID. To assess the effect of SFT, we use two human-preference models, HPSv2 [ 24 ] and PickScore [ 25 ] . The two scores are averaged over 500 images that the pretrained and the SFT checkpoints (ckpts) each generate from 500 held-out prompts. Inherited from DiffusionBench, our repository supports online evaluation, where intermediate checkpoints can be evaluated during training. Online evaluation will double the pretraining time and add about an hour to SFT. Appendix B explains each metric in more detail.
blocks.zh: 我们使用gFID测量生成质量 [21]. 具体来说,我们使用所有26k真实的预训图像作为参考集,并利用相同的预训提示生成26k图像. 两组图像用于gFID计算. 我们用PSNR、SSIM [22]、LPIPS [23] 和 rFID 来测量象征性的重建。 为了评估SFT的影响,我们使用了两个人偏好模型HPSv2 [24]和PickScore [25]. 这两个分数平均为500多张图片,预先训练的和SFT检查站(ckpts)各从500个被搁置的提示中产生. 我们的储存库继承自 " 传播奔驰 " ,支持在线评价,在培训期间可以对中间检查站进行评价。 在线评价将预训时间增加一倍并给SFT增加约一小时. 附 录 B更详细地解释了每个衡量标准。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Our best recipe
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 我们最好的食谱

blocks.en: Quality of generated images. Our best pretraining recipe is to use E2E-INVAE as tokenizer, 128-token captions, iREPA for acceleration with mean squared error loss, and EUPE as the external vision encoder. As shown in Table 3 , this method yields gFID = 8.32. We then apply standard SFT. As shown in Table 4 , SFT gives us HPSv2 = 0.2427 and PickScore = 19.61.
blocks.zh: 生成图像的质量 。 我们最好的预训配方是使用E2E-INVAE作为标定器,128个托肯字幕,iREPA用于以正方形错误损失加速,而EUPE则作为外视编码器. 如表3所示,这种方法的GFID=8.32。 然后我们应用标准SFT。 如表4所示,SFT给我们的HPSv2=0.2427,PickScore=19.61。

blocks.en: Efficiency. Using 4 × \times RTX 3090 GPUs, pretraining for 200 epochs takes 55 minutes, while SFT for 100 epochs takes 15 minutes. If using a single RTX 3090 GPU, pretraining for 200 epochs takes about 3 hours, while SFT for 100 epochs takes 21 minutes. Qualitative results after SFT are shown in Fig. 1 . Training the best recipe on a single GPU with the provided configuration (micro-batches of 64 with 4 gradient-accumulation steps, bf16) needs at least 10 GiB of VRAM, or 15 GiB if FID is evaluated during training. Also note that the image and text tokens are precomputed and cached, which takes about 15 minutes on one 3090 GPU.
blocks.zh: 效率。 使用 4×\times RTX 3090 GPU,200个纪元的预训需要55分钟,而SFT 100个纪元需要15分钟. 如果使用单个RTX 3090 GPU,200个纪元的预训需要约3小时,而100个纪元的SFT则需要21分钟. SFT后的定性结果以图1显示. 在单一的GPU上进行最佳配方培训,配备提供的配置(64个带4个梯度-积累步骤的微管,bf16)至少需要10个VRAM的GiB,如果在培训期间评估FID,则需要15个GiB. 也注意到图像和文本符被预先计算并被缓存,在一款3090 GPU上大约需要15分钟.

blocks.en: 4.2 Method comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 方法比较

blocks.en: Comparing E2E-INVAE and E2E-VAVAE . Both VAEs, trained by the REPA-E method [ 13 ] , are publicly available. To compare VAEs, both reconstruction and diffusability are important [ 26 ] . We first compare their reconstruction performance in Table 3 . Across the four metrics, E2E-INVAE is consistently better. We then compare how they support diffusion model training in Fig. 3 . We also observe that E2E-INVAE yields lower gFID scores or better diffusability.
blocks.zh: 比较E2E-INVAE和E2E-VAVAE. 通过REPA-E方法[13]培训的这两个VAE都是公开的. 为了比较VAE,重建与可扩散性都很重要[26]. 我们首先在表3中比较他们的重建业绩。 在四个衡量标准中,E2E-INVAE一直比较好。 然后我们比较它们如何支持图3的传播模式培训。 我们还注意到,E2E-INVAE的GFID分数较低,或者更易扩散。

blocks.en: Long caption vs. short caption. For each dog image, we provide a short caption (64 tokens maximum) and a long caption (128 tokens maximum). We compare them in MiniDog using E2E-INVAE in Table 3 . For this comparison, iREPA with EUPE encoder and MSE loss is used. Under E2E-INVAE, training with long captions yields lower gFID results. It indicates that long captions allow pretraining to converge faster than short captions.
blocks.zh: 长标题对短标题。 对于每个狗的形象,我们提供短标题(64个指使最大)和长标题(128个指使最大). 使用E2E-INVAE在表3中进行对比。 为作此比较,使用了iREPA与EUPE编码器和MSE损失. 在E2E-INVAE下,带有长标题的培训得出了较低的GFID结果. 它表明长标题可以使预训比短标题更快地汇合.

blocks.en: REPA vs . iREPA. We compare REPA, iREPA and baseline without REPA in Fig. 4 and Table 4 . We clearly see that REPA accelerates convergence of the baseline. Moreover, when using the EUPE encoder, iREPA converges faster than REPA. While REPA is slightly better under the PE-Spatial encoder (Table 4 ), the overall best performance is still achieved with iREPA (with EUPE). In addition, from Table 4 , using the MSE loss is superior to the cosine similarity loss for REPA and iREPA.
blocks.zh: REPA对. iREPA. 在图4和表4中,我们比较了REPA、iREPA和基线,而没有REPA。 我们清楚地看到,REPA加快了基线的趋同。 此外,在使用EUPE编码器时,iREPA的聚合速度快于REPA. 虽然REPA在PE-Spaceal编码器下略好(表4),但使用iREPA(使用EUPE)仍能实现总体最佳性能. 此外,从表4来看,使用MSE损失优于REPA和iREPA的同位素相似性损失。

blocks.en: Comparing different vision encoders. In Table 4 , we observe that the best encoder is DINOv2 for REPA and EUPE for iREPA. The EUPE encoder [ 15 ] is trained by distilling from DINOv3, PE-Core, and PE-Lang. Its spatially coherent dense features may explain its advantages for iREPA.
blocks.zh: 比较不同的视觉编码器. 在表4中,我们观察到最好的编码器是REPA的DINOv2和iREPA的EUPE。 EUPE编码器[15]是通过从DINOv3,PE-Core,和PE-Lang的蒸馏来训练的. 其空间相通的密集地貌可以解释其对iREPA的优点.

blocks.en: Benefit of supervised fine-tuning. In Table 4 , we compare generation quality of our pretrained model and SFT model. We use two pretrained reward models for scoring, which generally reflect how much people would like an image given its prompt. It is obvious that the HPSv2 and PickScore of the SFT model are consistently higher than those of the pretrained model. It is mainly because of the high quality SFT data. Note that FID (not shown) of the SFT model is higher than the pretrained model, because the high-quality SFT data pulls the model away from the pretraining distribution. Fig. 1 presents some cherry-picked images.
blocks.zh: 监督微调的好处。 在表4中,我们比较了我们预先训练过的模型和SFT模型的生成质量. 我们使用两个经过预先训练的奖励模式来评分,这些模式一般反映了人们对于一个形象的迅速性会有多想. 很明显,SFT型机车的HPSv2和PickScore一直高于预训型机车. 这主要是因为高质量的SFT数据. 注意SFT模型的FID(未显示)比预训模型高,因为高质量的SFT数据将模型从预训分布中拉出. 图一呈现出一些樱桃取材的图像.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: MiniDog does not build a comprehensive T2I model. Instead, it is a minimal project that focuses on dog image generation for the purpose of democratizing T2I training. Under our configuration, pretraining only takes about an hour on four 3090 GPUs and yields an FID of 8.32 at the resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 . Users can spend another 15 minutes on supervised fine-tuning, which improves image quality judged by pretrained reward models. The entire project including data, models, and code has been publicly open-sourced, with the hope to allow researchers to get started and evaluate their ideas.
blocks.zh: MiniDog没有建立全面的T2I模型. 取而代之的是,它是一个专注于狗形象生成的最低限度的项目,目的是实现T2I训练的民主化. 根据我们的配置,预训只需要大约一个小时,对4个3090GPU进行测试,并在256×256256\times 256的分辨率下产生8.32的FID. 用户还可以再花15分钟进行有监督的微调,这可以提高通过预先训练的奖励模型判断的图像质量. 包括数据,模型,和代码在内的整个项目都是公开的开源,希望让研究人员能够开始并评价他们的想法.
